Parish.title: Parish
Parish.description: A saved parish with its starting point, territory boundary polygon, and default koleda planning settings.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who saved this parish.

name.description: Name of the parish or church.

address.description: Formatted street address of the parish.

placeId.description: Google Places ID of the parish.

location.description: Geographic coordinates { lat, lng } of the parish center.

boundary.description: Bounded polygon vertex list (max 100 { lat, lng } objects) defining parish territory.

config.description: Planning configuration { priestCount, startTime, defaultVisitMinutes, travelMode, returnToParish }.

seasonConfig.description: Multi-day season scheduling configuration { startDate, endDate, weekdayStartTime, saturdayStartTime, weekendStartTime, dailyEndTime, weekdaysMask, excludedDates, defaultBreaks, planningRules, dayTimeOverrides }.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the parish was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the parish was last updated.

VisitStop.title: VisitStop
VisitStop.description: An individual house visit address belonging to a saved parish.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the parish owner.

label.description: Display label (house address or custom label).

durationMinutes.description: Planned visit duration in minutes (1 to 1440).

inBoundary.description: Whether the house lies inside the parish boundary.

included.description: Whether the house is included in the active koleda route plan while remaining saved in the parish repository.

visitDate.description: Scheduled YYYY-MM-DD date of pastoral visit during the koleda season, or empty if unassigned.

notes.description: Optional family name or visit notes.

isMultiUnit.description: Whether this building is a multi-unit apartment block.

unitsCount.description: Total number of apartments in the block (0 to 500).

minutesPerUnit.description: Default estimated minutes per apartment unit (1 to 60).

units.description: Bounded list (max 200) of apartment unit breakdown objects inside the block.

visitStatus.description: Field visit status for a single house: pending, accepted, absent, declined, or invited.

lastYearStatus.description: Archived visit status from the previous koleda season.

permanentDecline.description: Whether this address permanently declined pastoral visits across seasons.

manualOrder.description: Optional manual ordering index within the day/priest route (0 to 10000).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the house stop was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the house stop was last updated.

/parishes/{parishId}.description: Saved parishes, boundaries, and planner configurations owned by the signed-in user.

/parishes/{parishId}/stops/{stopId}.description: House visit stops belonging to a specific saved parish.
